title: Programs for summoning UFOs, such as Skywatchers, and special access programs

tellings.quote: you have these summoning programs of UFOs like Skywatchers this kind of modern version of this or whatever, but it seems like we've been doing this kind of in, you know, special access programs for a while.

plain: Michels thinks that efforts to summon UFOs, like Skywatchers, a modern private project that tries to call them in, have been going on for a long time inside special access programmes, the US government's most tightly restricted secret projects. He says this as his own view, without naming a source, in an episode about secret societies and the UFO cover-up.
